An Ordinance to
further amend the Sindh Local Government Elections Ordinance, 2000
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I,
22nd December 2000]
No. S.Legis.(16)/2000, dated 22‑12-2000.‑‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby published for
general information:
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑‑(1) This Ordinance may be called, the
Sindh Local Government Elections (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2000.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 18 of Sindh Ordinance No.X of 2000

ORDINANCE XVI OF 2000
ORDINANCE XVI OF 2000
Sindh Local
Government Elections (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2000
An Ordinance to
further amend the Sindh Local Government Elections Ordinance, 2000
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I,
22nd December 2000]
No. S.Legis.(16)/2000, dated 22‑12-2000.‑‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby published for
general information:
2. Amendment of section 18 of
Sindh Ordinance No.X of 2000.‑‑‑In the Sindh Local
Government Elections Ordinance, 2000, hereinafter referred to as the Ordinance
after section 18, the following new section shall be added, namely: '
" 18‑A. Casual
Vacancy,:‑‑(1) If the seat of a member becomes vacant during
the term of office of a council, a new member shall be elected through bye‑election
and such member shall hold office for the remaining part of such term: provided
that all bye‑elections shall be held once a year on dates fixed by the
Chief Election Commissioner.
(2) The vacancy in the office of
Nazim shall be filled by officiating Nazim elected by the members of the
council concerned by majority votes: provided that:
(a) The member so elected shall
continue to hold his substantive ‑ office as member till the bye‑election
to fill .the vacant office is held;
(b) The Naib Nazim will not be
eligible for bye‑election or to be
officiating Nazim;
(c) In the event of temporary
absence of the Nazim, the Naib Nazim of the council concerned shall deputize in
place of the Nazim."

An Ordinance to

[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I,
22nd December 2000]
No. S.Legis.(16)/2000, dated 22‑12-2000.‑‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby published for
general information:
3. Amendment of section 35 of
Sindh Ordinance No.X of 2000.‑‑‑In the Ordinance, after
section 35 the following new section shall be inserted, namely:
"35‑A. Power of
the Chief. Election Commissioner to punish for contempt.
The Chief
Election Commissioner shall have the same power as the High Court has to punish
any person for contempt of Court and the Contempt of Court Act, 1976 (XLVI of
1976) shall have effect accordingly as if reference therein to a
"Judge" was reference to the "Chief Election Commissioner.
".
